description: Get a prepress checklist tailored to the job. Pass `product` (flyer, brochure, book-perfect, book-saddle, business-card, poster, packaging, large-format), `colour` (cmyk, cmyk-spot, black-white) and optionally `finishes` (comma-separated: spot-uv, foil, emboss, die-cut, varnish, lamination, perforation, fold). Returns grouped checks: document setup, colour, images, type, finishing files, export and delivery, with the figures to confirm with your printer. Items are common practice; the printer's own spec sheet always wins.
name: print_file_checklist
title: Print file checklist
